text:
Evan L.: Hi everyone, quick security onboarding Qs as I finish setup: 1) Is a personal phone allowed for MFA until my YubiKey arrives? 2) The phish-sim email mentioned a "report" button  where is that in Gmail? 3) My Mac says FileVault is Off  can IT remote-enable it or do I need to run something? 4) How do I request sandbox KMS access for a workshop later this week?

Mira (People Ops): Welcome Evan! :wave: Short answers: personal TOTP ok temporarily, YubiKey required for prod roles. For Gmail, the "Report Phish" button is in the overflow menu (three dots) in the web client; mobile clients have a "Report" option. If FileVault is Off, please run the enroll script or open a ticket. For KMS, file a ticket and include the workshop repo and manager approval.

IT Helpdesk: @Evan L. remote enable is limited for personal devices  we can only guide you. Preferred: run `sudo /opt/redwood/enroll_device.sh --mdm` then `fdesetup enable -user $(whoami)`. If you're blocked, open a "BYOD help" ticket and we'll schedule a quick support session. For corporate loaner, use the loaner form.

Security Team: For the workshop sandbox, we can grant time-limited `kms:DevSandboxDecrypt` if manager approves and you complete the Data Handling mini-quiz (LMS). Phish sim: reporting doesn't penalize you; it's used for training. If you clicked a simulated link, DM security and we'll guide next steps.

Evan L.: Thanks  one last nit: Authy desktop vs phone  which is preferred?

IT Helpdesk: Phone Authy or Okta Verify preferred for portability. Desktop Authy ok on personal machines but not allowed on shared or corp-managed devices. If you need a temporary soft token, request it in the ticket.

Onboard Bot: Reminder set  Data Handling mini-quiz due in 2 days. Phishing sim window for new hires: 1768275000 - 1768361400.
